description: List every FRC team that competed in a given season year, paginated in groups of 500. Returns full team profiles. Use to scope team enumeration to a single competition season. Lighter variants: get_teams_by_year_simple, get_teams_by_year_keys.

page_num.description: Zero-indexed page number for paginated team listings. TBA returns up to 500 teams per page; increment until the response is empty to enumerate all teams.

year.description: FRC competition season year. FRC began in 1992 and runs one game per year (e.g., 2023 = "Charged Up", 2024 = "Crescendo", 2025 = "Reefscape"). Must be between 1992 and next calendar year.

name: get_teams_by_year
